name: Red Fox
description: Red foxes are adaptable animals often rescued after road accidents or injury. They are rehabilitated in quiet woodland-style enclosures.

name: Hedgehog
description: Hedgehogs are rescued after garden accidents or illness and are cared for before being released into safe habitats.

name: Barn Owl
description: Barn owls are treated for wing injuries and assessed for flight before being released near open countryside.

name: Badger
description: Badgers recover in quiet, underground-style enclosures before returning to woodland environments.

name: Otter
description: Otters are rehabilitated near water and trained in swimming and fishing skills before release.

name: Red Squirrel
description: Red squirrels are a protected species and are cared for in woodland enclosures to encourage natural behaviours.

name: Roe Deer
description: Roe deer recover in large outdoor paddocks to regain strength and mobility before release.

name: Grey Seal
description: Grey seals are rescued when stranded on beaches and rehabilitated before being returned to the sea.

name: Mallard Duck
description: Mallard ducks are cared for near ponds and wetland areas before being released.

name: Mute Swan
description: Mute swans are treated for fishing line injuries and gradually reintroduced to water environments.
